ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 82% high-intensity pixels (white/off-white) and 18% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) localized to edges and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone (approx. coordinates [0.15, 0.20] to [0.85, 0.80] relative to fluke bounds). Low-intensity black banding follows the entire trailing edge boundary and the inferior peduncle insertion. Diffuse yellow-brown mottling clusters scattered across the central high-intensity zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 7% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric sweep; left lobe follows a sharp convex curve tapering distally with an upward orientation. Right lobe exhibits a broader, more vertical convex sweep with a wider distal chord.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Minor spatial detection of small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (3-6 pixel diameter) localized on the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and missing sections of the distal trailing edge on the left lobe, indicating acquired physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast vertical water drainage streams and droplets shedding from the distal tip of the left lobe.
